description: (Rb)₂NaNdI₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Rb clusters inside a NaNdI₆ framework. In each Rb cluster, Rb is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaNdI₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.14 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NdI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-I bond lengths are 3.10 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Nd atom.
